collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder tangles the words of the first catch blessing: laugh first, or start again with dignity.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the little gathering for the first catch of the season, (name1) stands up to say the traditional words: "May your nets be full and your fish be fat." What (he/she) actually says, with great solemnity, is: "May your fish be full and your nets be fat." A pause. (He/she) tries again. "May your fats be... nish..."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) closes (his/her) eyes, takes a deep breath, and says the words perfectly, slowly, every one in its place. Then (he/she) sits down. Then, very quietly, to nobody in particular, (he/she) says, "Fat nets," and the people sitting nearest shake with silent laughter for the rest of the gathering.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) laughs before anyone else can, a big warm laugh, and everyone joins in. "Fat nets," (he/she) says, wiping (his/her) eyes. "Why not?" That season the fishers call their nets "the fat ones." The catch is good, whether or not the words had anything to do with it.
